name: Active Cube-Coordinate Count
definition: For a graph $G$ displayed as a subgraph of the Boolean cube $Q_X$, let $Y(G)\subseteq X$ be the set of coordinates that label at least one edge of $G$. The active cube-coordinate count is $a_{\square}(G\hookrightarrow Q_X)=|Y(G)|$.
parameters: A specified embedding of $G$ as a subgraph of a Boolean cube $Q_X$.
normalization: Ambient coordinates that label no edge of $G$ are suppressed. No inducedness or isometry assumption is imposed.
comments: For an isometric cube embedding of a connected partial cube, this agrees with the number of $\Theta$-classes. For a general displayed cube subgraph it depends on the chosen embedding and is therefore recorded as a presentation invariant.
